metadata.description: v11: (1) Carousel now shows 12 random cards instead of all 200, and always includes a music-industry role (#136 Music producer) and a video-game role (#137 Game designer) on every reload; animation retimed to 40s. (2) Carousel background is a vertical green-to-blue horizon gradient (deep green ground -> thin blank/white horizon line -> light blue sky) for a 3D depth effect; the attract question is dark text with a light shadow for contrast on the light sky. (3) The full 200-card board is Fisher-Yates shuffled on every page load so users must browse. (4) Removed the count numbers from the All/Automate/Assist/Both filter buttons (card numbers kept). (5) Added centered small legal text at the bottom: 'Copyright & Trademark Stardock Corporation/Clairvoyance.' All 200 roles, 10 industry colors, flip/art/picks/responsive unchanged. Verified in Firefox: random carousel, horizon background, shuffled board, number-free filters, legal line.

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
<title>Clairvoyance Role Cards</title>
<style>
  :root {
    --bg:#0a0e1a; --panel:#121830; --card:#151d38; --card-edge:#2a3560;
    --text:#e8ecff; --muted:#8b95b8;
    --blue:#3b82f6; --indigo:#6366f1; --amber:#f59e0b;
  }
  * { box-sizing:border-box; margin:0; padding:0; }
  body { font-family:'Segoe UI',system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;
    background:radial-gradient(ellipse at top,#16203f 0%,var(--bg) 60%);
    color:var(--text); min-height:100vh; padding:24px; overflow-x:hidden; }
  .app { max-width:1400px; margin:0 auto; }

  /* ===== CAROUSEL ===== */
  .attract { position:relative; overflow:hidden;
    background:linear-gradient(to top,
      #052e1c 0%,
      #0a4a2e 26%,
      #16794a 46%,
      #7fd8b0 52.5%,
      #ffffff 53.6%,
      #cfeafe 54.8%,
      #9ccdf3 72%,
      #d6ecfb 100%);
    border:1px solid var(--card-edge); border-radius:16px;
    padding:28px 0; margin-bottom:40px; box-shadow:0 8px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.4); }
  .attract-question { text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px; min-height:40px; padding:0 14px; }
  .attract-question .q { font-size:clamp(17px,4.5vw,26px); font-weight:700; line-height:1.25;
    color:#0b2e4a; text-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(255,255,255,.45); }
  .carousel-track { display:flex; gap:24px; padding:8px 24px; width:max-content;
    animation:scrollCards 40s linear infinite; }
  .attract:hover .carousel-track { animation-play-state:paused; }
  @keyframes scrollCards { 0%{transform:translateX(0)} 100%{transform:translateX(-50%)} }
  .carousel-card { flex-shrink:0; width:214px; height:306px; background:var(--card);
    border:1px solid var(--ind,var(--card-edge)); border-radius:14px; padding:16px;
    display:flex; flex-direction:column; position:relative; overflow:hidden;
    box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.3); transition:transform .3s; }
  .carousel-card:hover { transform:translateY(-6px); }
  .accent { position:absolute; top:0; left:0; right:0; height:4px; background:var(--ind,var(--blue)); }
  .c-top { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-top:8px; margin-bottom:10px; }
  .num { font-size:13px; font-weight:700; color:var(--ind,var(--muted)); }
  .fit-chip { font-size:10px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.5px; text-transform:uppercase;
    padding:3px 8px; border-radius:6px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);
    border:1px solid var(--card-edge); color:var(--text); white-space:nowrap; }
  .carousel-card .name { font-size:18px; font-weight:700; margin-bottom:10px; line-height:1.2; }
  .carousel-card .desc { font-size:12px; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.5; flex:1; }
  .domain-chip { align-self:flex-start; font-size:11px; font-weight:600; padding:4px 10px;
    border-radius:999px; background:var(--ind,var(--blue)); color:#0a0e1a; margin-top:8px; }

  /* ===== BOARD HEADER / FILTERS ===== */
  .board-header { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-bottom:24px; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:12px; }
  .board-header h1 { font-size:24px; }
  .board-header .hint { color:var(--muted); font-size:14px; }
  .filters { display:flex; gap:12px; margin-bottom:24px; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; }
  .filter-btn { padding:8px 16px; border:1px solid var(--card-edge); background:transparent;
    color:var(--muted); border-radius:20px; font-size:13px; cursor:pointer; transition:all .2s; }
  .filter-btn:hover { border-color:var(--blue); color:var(--text); }
  .filter-btn.active { background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--blue),var(--indigo));
    border:none; color:#fff; font-weight:600; }
  .filter-btn .count { opacity:.7; font-size:11px; margin-left:4px; }
  .picks { margin-left:auto; text-align:right; }
  .picks .count { font-size:18px; font-weight:700; color:var(--amber); }
  .picks .label { font-size:12px; color:var(--muted); }

  /* picks tray */
  .picks-tray { display:flex; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px; margin-bottom:24px;
    padding:12px 16px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.03); border:1px solid var(--card-edge); border-radius:12px; }
  .picks-tray[hidden] { display:none; }
  .picks-tray-label { font-size:12px; font-weight:700; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.5px; color:var(--amber); }
  .picks-chips { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px; flex:1; min-width:0; }
  .pick-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:4px; font-size:12px; padding:4px 4px 4px 12px;
    border-radius:999px; background:var(--card); border:1px solid var(--card-edge); }
  .pick-x { border:none; background:transparent; color:var(--muted); cursor:pointer; font-size:15px; line-height:1; padding:0 5px; border-radius:50%; }
  .pick-x:hover { color:#ef4444; }
  .picks-clear { font-size:11px; color:var(--muted); background:transparent; border:1px solid var(--card-edge);
    border-radius:8px; padding:5px 10px; cursor:pointer; white-space:nowrap; }
  .picks-clear:hover { color:var(--text); border-color:var(--blue); }

  /* ===== CARD FLIP ===== */
  .board { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(184px,1fr)); gap:20px; justify-items:center; }
  .card-wrapper { position:relative; width:100%; max-width:224px; aspect-ratio:2 / 3; cursor:pointer; perspective:1100px; }
  .card { position:absolute; inset:0; transform-style:preserve-3d;
    transition:transform .6s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); }
  .card.flipped { transform:rotateY(180deg); }
  .card-wrapper:hover .card:not(.flipped) { transform:translateY(-8px); }
  .card-wrapper:hover .card.flipped { transform:rotateY(180deg) translateY(-8px); }
  .card-face { position:absolute; inset:0; -webkit-backface-visibility:hidden; backface-visibility:hidden;
    border-radius:14px; background:var(--card); border:1px solid var(--ind,var(--card-edge));
    box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.3); overflow:hidden; display:flex; flex-direction:column; padding:14px; }
  .card-face.card-back { transform:rotateY(180deg); background:linear-gradient(135deg,#151d38,#111830); }

  /* front */
  .card-front .top-bar { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-top:6px; margin-bottom:12px; }
  .card-front .name { font-size:17px; font-weight:700; line-height:1.2; margin-bottom:8px; }
  .card-front .desc { font-size:12px; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.5; flex:1; }
  .card-front .stats { border-top:1px solid var(--card-edge); padding-top:10px; margin-top:8px; }
  .stat { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:8px; font-size:11px; margin-bottom:5px; }
  .stat .label { color:var(--muted); }
  .stat .value { color:var(--text); text-align:right; font-weight:600; }
  .tap-hint { text-align:center; font-size:10px; color:var(--muted); margin-top:10px; letter-spacing:.3px; }

  /* back */
  .card-art { position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:0; overflow:hidden; border-radius:14px; pointer-events:none;
    background-image:
      linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(10,14,26,.50) 0%, rgba(10,14,26,.64) 55%, rgba(10,14,26,.74) 100%),
      url("data:image/jpeg;base64,");
    background-size: cover, cover; background-position: center, center; background-repeat: no-repeat, no-repeat; }
  .back-scroll { flex:1 1 auto; min-height:0; overflow-y:auto; position:relative; z-index:1; }
  .back-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar { width:5px; }
  .back-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background:var(--card-edge); border-radius:3px; }
  .card-back .title { font-size:16px; font-weight:700; line-height:1.2; margin-bottom:8px; }
  .chips { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:6px; margin-bottom:8px; }
  .card-back .desc { font-size:11px; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.5; margin-bottom:10px; }
  .card-back .stats { margin-bottom:10px; }
  .paths-toggle { width:100%; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;
    padding:7px 10px; border:1px solid var(--ind,var(--card-edge)); background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);
    color:var(--text); border-radius:8px; font-size:12px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; transition:background .2s; }
  .paths-toggle:hover { background:rgba(255,255,255,.08); }
  .chev { display:inline-block; transition:transform .3s; }
  .paths-toggle.open .chev { transform:rotate(180deg); }
  .paths { max-height:0; overflow:hidden; visibility:hidden; transition:max-height .32s ease, visibility 0s linear .32s; }
  .paths.open { max-height:360px; visibility:visible; transition:max-height .32s ease, visibility 0s; }
  .paths-inner { padding-top:8px; }
  .paths .label { display:block; font-size:10px; color:var(--muted); margin-bottom:5px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.5px; }
  .outcome { display:block; width:100%; text-align:left; font-family:inherit; color:var(--text);
    background:transparent; font-size:11px; padding:6px 8px; border:1px solid var(--card-edge); border-radius:6px;
    margin-bottom:5px; cursor:pointer; transition:all .2s; }
  .outcome:hover { border-color:var(--ind,var(--blue)); }
  .outcome.active { border-color:var(--ind,var(--blue)); background:rgba(255,255,255,.07); }
  .similar { margin-top:8px; }
  .sim-val { font-size:11px; color:var(--text); line-height:1.4; }
  .footer { flex:0 0 auto; display:flex; gap:6px; margin-top:10px; position:relative; z-index:1; }
  .btn { flex:1; padding:7px; border:1px solid var(--card-edge); background:transparent; color:var(--text);
    border-radius:7px; font-size:11px; cursor:pointer; transition:all .2s; }
  .btn:hover { border-color:var(--ind,var(--blue)); }
  .btn.primary { background:#1f9d57; border:1px solid transparent; color:#fff; font-weight:600; }
  .btn.primary:hover { background:#23ab60; border-color:transparent; }
  .btn.primary.saved { background:#15713f; border:1px solid #0a3d21; color:#eafff1; }
  .btn.primary.saved:hover { background:#18804a; border-color:#0a3d21; }

  /* legend */
  .legend { display:flex; gap:18px; justify-content:center; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-top:32px; padding-top:20px; border-top:1px solid var(--card-edge); }
  .legend-item { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; font-size:12px; color:var(--muted); }
  .legend-dot { width:11px; height:11px; border-radius:3px; }
  .legal { text-align:center; font-size:11px; color:var(--muted); margin-top:22px; padding-bottom:4px; }

  /* ===== INPUT: keyboard / touch ===== */
  .card-wrapper, .btn, .paths-toggle, .filter-btn, .outcome, .pick-x, .picks-clear { touch-action: manipulation; }
  .card-wrapper:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #fff; outline-offset:3px; border-radius:16px; }
  .btn:focus-visible, .paths-toggle:focus-visible, .filter-btn:focus-visible,
  .outcome:focus-visible, .pick-x:focus-visible, .picks-clear:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #fff; outline-offset:2px; }

  /* ===== RESPONSIVE ===== */
  @media (max-width:620px) {
    body { padding:14px; }
    .attract { padding:20px 0; margin-bottom:28px; }
    .carousel-track { gap:16px; padding:8px 16px; }
    .carousel-card { width:168px; height:252px; }
    .board { grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(150px,1fr)); gap:14px; }
    .card-wrapper { max-width:200px; }
    .board-header h1 { font-size:20px; }
    .picks { margin-left:0; text-align:left; }
    .legend { gap:12px; }
  }
  @media (max-width:380px) {
    .board { grid-template-columns:1fr; }
    .card-wrapper { max-width:260px; margin:0 auto; }
  }
</style>
</head>

    {"num": 195, "name": "Compliance officer", "fit": "assist", "domain": "Government & Social", "risk": "Low–Moderate", "human": "Judgment, accountability", "similar": "Risk Analyst, Auditor", "outcomes": ["Map controls", "Test evidence", "Draft reports"], "desc": "Maps controls, tests evidence, and drafts the reports."},
    {"num": 196, "name": "Internal investigator", "fit": "assist", "domain": "Government & Social", "risk": "Low–Moderate", "human": "Judgment, conclusions", "similar": "Compliance Officer, Fraud Investigator", "outcomes": ["Search records", "Build timelines", "Flag inconsistencies"], "desc": "Searches records and builds timelines for human review."},
    {"num": 197, "name": "Accessibility specialist", "fit": "assist", "domain": "Government & Social", "risk": "Low–Moderate", "human": "Validation, design judgment", "similar": "UX Designer, QA Analyst", "outcomes": ["Run accessibility checks", "Suggest remediations", "Validate inclusive design"], "desc": "Runs checks and suggests fixes; experts validate inclusive design."},
    {"num": 198, "name": "Disaster-response coordinator", "fit": "assist", "domain": "Government & Social", "risk": "Low", "human": "Directing operations", "similar": "Emergency Manager, Logistics Lead", "outcomes": ["Integrate alerts & maps", "Track resources", "Prep situation reports"], "desc": "Pulls alerts, resources, and maps; people direct operations."},
    {"num": 199, "name": "Community outreach coordinator", "fit": "assist", "domain": "Government & Social", "risk": "Low–Moderate", "human": "Relationships, trust", "similar": "Outreach Specialist, Program Coordinator", "outcomes": ["Segment audiences", "Draft multilingual materials", "Track engagement"], "desc": "Segments audiences, drafts multilingual materials, and tracks engagement."},
    {"num": 200, "name": "Ethics and AI-governance analyst", "fit": "assist", "domain": "Government & Social", "risk": "Low–Moderate", "human": "Accountability, judgment", "similar": "Risk Analyst, Compliance Officer", "outcomes": ["Maintain model inventories", "Run risk assessments", "Monitor controls"], "desc": "Keeps model inventories, risk assessments, and monitoring honest."}
  ];

  function indColor(domain) { return industryColors[domain] || "#3b82f6"; }

  function shuffle(a) {
    for (var i = a.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      var j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
      var t = a[i]; a[i] = a[j]; a[j] = t;
    }
    return a;
  }
  function roleByNum(n) {
    for (var i = 0; i < roles.length; i++) { if (roles[i].num === n) return roles[i]; }
    return null;
  }

  // Shuffle the full 200-card deck so the board order changes every page load.
  shuffle(roles);

  // Carousel: 12 random cards, always including a music (#136) and a video-game (#137) role.
  var must = [roleByNum(136), roleByNum(137)].filter(Boolean);
  var mustNums = must.map(function (r) { return r.num; });
  var pool = roles.filter(function (r) { return mustNums.indexOf(r.num) === -1; });
  shuffle(pool);
  var carouselPick = shuffle(must.concat(pool.slice(0, 12 - must.length)));

  var carouselTrack = document.getElementById('carouselTrack');
  var cHTML = '';
  for (var i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
    carouselPick.forEach(function (r) {
      cHTML +=
        '<div class="carousel-card" style="--ind:' + indColor(r.domain) + '">' +
          '<div class="accent"></div>' +
          '<div class="c-top"><span class="num">#' + r.num + '</span><span class="fit-chip">' + fitLabels[r.fit] + '</span></div>' +
          '<div class="name">' + r.name + '</div>' +
          '<div class="desc">' + r.desc + '</div>' +
          '<div class="domain-chip">' + r.domain + '</div>' +
        '</div>';
    });
  }
  carouselTrack.innerHTML = cHTML;

  var board = document.getElementById('board');
  var picked = {};

  function pickBtn(name) {
    var sel = (window.CSS && CSS.escape) ? CSS.escape(name) : name.replace(/"/g, '\\"');
    return board.querySelector('.btn.primary[data-name="' + sel + '"]');
  }
  function renderPicks() {
    var names = Object.keys(picked);
    document.getElementById('pickCount').textContent = names.length;
    var tray = document.getElementById('picksTray');
    tray.hidden = names.length === 0;
    document.getElementById('picksChips').innerHTML = names.map(function (n) {
      return '<span class="pick-chip">' + n +
        '<button class="pick-x" title="Remove" data-n="' + n.replace(/"/g, '"') +
        '" onclick="removePick(this.getAttribute(\'data-n\'))">×</button></span>';
    }).join('');
  }
  function removePick(name) {
    delete picked[name];
    var b = pickBtn(name);
    if (b) { b.textContent = 'Save to board'; b.classList.remove('saved'); }
    renderPicks();
  }

  function renderBoard(filter) {
    filter = filter || 'all';
    board.innerHTML = '';
    roles.forEach(function (r) {
      if (filter !== 'all' && r.fit !== filter) return;
      var ic = indColor(r.domain);

      var outcomesHTML = r.outcomes.map(function (o) {
        return '<button type="button" class="outcome" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); toggleOutcome(this)">' + o + '</button>';
      }).join('');

      var wrapper = document.createElement('div');
      wrapper.className = 'card-wrapper';
      wrapper.style.setProperty('--ind', ic);
      wrapper.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var card = wrapper.querySelector('.card');
        if (card) card.classList.toggle('flipped');
      });
      wrapper.tabIndex = 0;
      wrapper.setAttribute('role', 'button');
      wrapper.setAttribute('aria-label', r.name + ' — ' + fitLabels[r.fit] + '. Press Enter to flip.');
      wrapper.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.target !== wrapper) return;
        if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Spacebar') {
          e.preventDefault();
          var card = wrapper.querySelector('.card');
          if (card) card.classList.toggle('flipped');
        }
      });

      wrapper.innerHTML =
        '<div class="card">' +
          '<div class="card-face card-front">' +
            '<div class="accent"></div>' +
            '<div class="top-bar"><span class="num">#' + r.num + '</span><span class="fit-chip">' + fitLabels[r.fit] + '</span></div>' +
            '<div class="name">' + r.name + '</div>' +
            '<div class="desc">' + r.desc + '</div>' +
            '<div class="stats">' +
              '<div class="stat"><span class="label">Domain</span><span class="value">' + r.domain + '</span></div>' +
              '<div class="stat"><span class="label">Automation</span><span class="value">' + r.risk + '</span></div>' +
              '<div class="stat"><span class="label">Human owns</span><span class="value">' + r.human + '</span></div>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<div class="tap-hint">Tap to flip ⟳</div>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="card-face card-back">' +
            '<div class="card-art"></div>' +
            '<div class="accent"></div>' +
            '<div class="back-scroll">' +
              '<div class="title">' + r.name + '</div>' +
              '<div class="chips"><span class="domain-chip">' + r.domain + '</span><span class="fit-chip">Path Fit: ' + fitLabels[r.fit] + '</span></div>' +
              '<div class="desc">' + r.desc + '</div>' +
              '<button class="paths-toggle" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); togglePaths(this)">View Paths <span class="chev">▾</span></button>' +
              '<div class="paths"><div class="paths-inner">' +
                '<span class="label">Details</span>' +
                '<div class="stats">' +
                  '<div class="stat"><span class="label">Domain</span><span class="value">' + r.domain + '</span></div>' +
                  '<div class="stat"><span class="label">Automation</span><span class="value">' + r.risk + '</span></div>' +
                  '<div class="stat"><span class="label">Human owns</span><span class="value">' + r.human + '</span></div>' +
                '</div>' +
                '<span class="label">Suggested paths</span>' + outcomesHTML +
                '<div class="similar"><span class="label">Similar roles</span><div class="sim-val">' + r.similar + '</div></div>' +
              '</div></div>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<div class="footer">' +
              '<button class="btn" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); flipBack(this)">Back</button>' +
              '<button class="btn primary' + (picked[r.name] ? ' saved' : '') + '" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); addToPicks(this, this.getAttribute(\'data-name\'))" data-name="' + r.name.replace(/"/g, '"') + '">' + (picked[r.name] ? 'Saved ✓' : 'Save to board') + '</button>' +
            '</div>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>';

      board.appendChild(wrapper);
    });
  }

  function togglePaths(btn) {
    btn.classList.toggle('open');
    var p = btn.nextElementSibling;
    if (!p) return;
    p.classList.toggle('open');
    if (p.classList.contains('open')) {
      var sc = btn.closest('.back-scroll');
      if (sc) setTimeout(function () { sc.scrollTop = sc.scrollHeight; }, 340);
    }
  }
  function toggleOutcome(el) { el.classList.toggle('active'); }
  function flipBack(btn) {
    var card = btn.closest('.card');
    if (card) card.classList.remove('flipped');
  }
  function addToPicks(btn, name) {
    if (picked[name]) { delete picked[name]; btn.textContent = 'Save to board'; btn.classList.remove('saved'); }
    else { picked[name] = true; btn.textContent = 'Saved ✓'; btn.classList.add('saved'); }
    renderPicks();
  }

  var legend = document.getElementById('legend');
  var lHTML = '';
  Object.keys(industryColors).forEach(function (dom) {
    lHTML += '<div class="legend-item"><span class="legend-dot" style="background:' + industryColors[dom] + '"></span>' + dom + '</div>';
  });
  legend.innerHTML = lHTML;

  Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn'), function (btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn'), function (b) { b.classList.remove('active'); });
      btn.classList.add('active');
      renderBoard(btn.dataset.filter);
    });
  });

  document.getElementById('picksClear').addEventListener('click', function () {
    Object.keys(picked).forEach(function (n) {
      var b = pickBtn(n);
      if (b) { b.textContent = 'Save to board'; b.classList.remove('saved'); }
      delete picked[n];
    });
    renderPicks();
  });

  renderBoard();
  renderPicks();
</script>
